text:
kevin (support): Heads-up: multiple customers reporting 502 / 504s after the morning rollout. Several on hosted API v2 endpoints. Escalating to oncall.

maria (oncall): Thanks — any spike graphs or traces? Which route/model?

kevin (support): Traffic spike ~08:20 UTC after rollforward. Errors primarily: `502 Bad Gateway` and `upstream prematurely closed connection`. A customer repro attached: curl to /v2/generate times out or 502.

kevin (support): repro curl:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate --max-time 10
```

maria (oncall): @deploy-bot what was promoted at 08:15?

deploy-bot: Canary promotion: `services/api-router` config `enable_prefetch=true` + routing matrix update -> promoted from canary -> prod at 08:14:52 UTC (run id: r-2026-0715-0814).

olivia (eng-sre): That config toggles prefetch and kvcache behavior. We've seen issues when prefetch overlaps with new batching window — can cause upstreams to drop. Pulling traces now.

sanjay (infra): Looking at gateway logs: a lot of `context deadline exceeded` from backend pool `inference-backend-4`. Latency to GPU nodes increased right after promotion. Possibly overloaded due to prefetch causing duplicate requests.

olivia (eng-sre): Grabbed a few trace IDs from an affected request: `trace=7c1f2a4b`. Backend logs show `connection reset by peer` followed by `503` from upstream.

kevin (support): Customer impact numbers: 12% of requests for paid customers across EU/NA hitting 5xx windows 08:20-08:40. Some billing alerts firing.

maria (oncall): Immediate step: do we have a safe quick rollback? If yes, do it and notify affected customers. If not, patch config to disable prefetch.

sanjay (infra): We can rollback routing at the control plane — will revert the promoted matrix and flag. Rolling back now (command issued).

deploy-bot: Rollback started: reverting `r-2026-0715-0814` promotion -> unpromote `enable_prefetch` (jobs queued). Estimated completion ~2m.

olivia (eng-sre): While rollback runs, enable circuit-breaker on api-router to fail-fast to Dedicated capacity to reduce retries: `/ops/burnin circuit enable api-router 30s`

maria (oncall): Executed. Also increasing shedder thresholds to throttle noisy clients: `/ops/shedder set rate_limit=50/s`

sanjay (infra): Rollback complete at 08:17:40 UTC. Routing matrix reverted. Backends are draining duplicate prefetches. Monitoring error rate...

olivia (eng-sre): Error rate dropping: from 12% -> 2% in 90s. Traces show backends recover and KV cache warm-up now disabled.

kevin (support): Pinged affected customers, submitted interim status note. One customer asked for postmortem and whether tokens billed during errors will be credited.

maria (oncall): Good containment. Next: we need full RCA. Assigning olivia + sanjay to triage and produce a short postmortem (include repro steps, which flag combo caused amplification, short-term mitigation, and rollback timeline). Kevin to coordinate customer credits + comms.

olivia (eng-sre): Initial hypothesis: `enable_prefetch=true` combined with the new `batching_window_ms=0` in the rollout led to request fan-out to multiple backend replicas while KV cache not yet populated, causing connection saturation. Repro plan: run scaled canary with prefetch on and batching_window set to 0 in staging with traffic mimic.

sanjay (infra): I'll snapshot the kernel and host metrics for the period and collect netstack/fd counts. Also capture the exact deploy artifacts for audit.

kevin (support): Thanks team. I'll update support channel and escalate billing credits to finance. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): Closing incident channel for now. Keep updates in #postmortems when draft is ready. If error rate climbs again, reopen here.

deploy-bot: Incident note: rollback completed, error rate reduced, owners: olivia (RCA), sanjay (infra metrics), kevin (customer comms).
